title: Revisiting GAN with Bayes-Optimal Discrimination
abstract: arXiv:2510.25609v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We approach generative adversarial network (GAN) training from its original real-versus-fake classification viewpoint, replacing the cross-entropy discriminator objective with an upper bound on the Bayes error rate (BER). Using the Bayes optimal learning threshold (BOLT) loss, we formulate an adversarial game in which the discriminator tightens this bound and the generator maximizes it. We characterize the unrestricted optimal discriminator and show that, under balanced class priors, the population game is equivalent to minimizing total variation between the data and generator distributions. Restricting the bounded discriminator to be 1-Lipschitz yields BOLT-GAN. For balanced priors and the full discriminator class, we establish upper and lower bounds relating its population discrepancy to Wasserstein-1 distance on bounded domains. Controlled experiments on four image-generation benchmarks show improved sample quality and coverage ov

translated_title: 基于贝叶斯最优判别的GAN重探
translated_abstract: 我们从生成对抗网络（GAN）训练最初的真实与伪造分类视角出发，用贝叶斯错误率（BER）的上界替代交叉熵判别器目标。利用贝叶斯最优学习阈值（BOLT）损失，我们构建了一个对抗博弈：判别器收紧该上界，而生成器最大化它。我们刻画了无约束下的最优判别器，并证明在类别先验平衡的情况下，该总体博弈等价于最小化数据分布与生成器分布之间的总变差。将有界判别器限制为1-Lipschitz，即得到BOLT-GAN。对于平衡先验和完整判别器类，我们建立了将其总体差异与有界域上Wasserstein-1距离相关联的上下界。在四个图像生成基准上的受控实验表明，该方法的样本质量和覆盖度均有提升。
tldr: 该论文提出用贝叶斯错误率上界（BOLT损失）替代传统交叉熵目标来重构GAN训练，理论上证明其对抗博弈等价于最小化数据与生成分布间的总变差，并与Wasserstein-1距离建立关联，实验显示样本质量与覆盖度均得到改善。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates GAN training by replacing the cross-entropy discriminator objective with a BOLT loss that upper-bounds the Bayes error rate, proving the resulting adversarial game equivalently minimizes total variation between data and generator distributions and establishing connections to the Wasserstein-1 distance, with experiments demonstrating improved sample quality and coverage.
